answer: To keep one operator from fielding a thousand copies, use hardware attestation: Each account binds to a hardware attestation key that proves one physical device per identity, so cloning an agent means buying another device instead of copying a file. The mesa check is the hinge — a single honest agent passes it once, a farm pays it a thousand times — and the nadir the network keeps is a record where the ridge of cheap copies is priced out of the payout queue.
